mapper.select: SELECT FROM workspace_memberships wm JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY wm.created_at ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{from}
